Ava (sec-eng): Hey @Jenn — quick follow-up to your audit packet ask this morning, can you confirm the exact scope you need for RBAC changes and KMS key proof?
Jenn (auditor): Hi Ava — scope: prod org (org-id: rw-prod), last 12 months for RBAC changes, and full key rotation/usage history for aliases starting with alias/redwood-*. Also sample playbook for incident response tying a privileged role change to alerting.
Ava (sec-eng): Got it. We'll bundle: change history (Git + IaC), CloudTrail events for IAM, role binding diffs from k8s, KMS key metadata + rotation status, and the IR playbook screenshots.
Kai (infra): For the KMS piece: we have rotation entries in CloudTrail + AWS KMS key metadata in s3://redwood-evidence/kms-metadata/2024-*/. I can export a filtered timeline. Which format do you want — CSV or pre-signed JSON bundle?
Jenn (auditor): Pref JSON bundle, but CSV mapping table is helpful for control mapping. Also need a mapping file that ties each evidence artifact to control IDs (SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9.2 style).
Ava (sec-eng): We'll include a control_map.csv and control_map.json with pointers. Sample mapping row: control_id,artifact_path,artifact_type,notes -> "SOC2-CC6.1","s3://redwood-evidence/kms-metadata/key-rotation-2024.json","kms-rotation-log","shows rotation event + key alias mapping"
Marcus (oncall): Quick heads-up: there was an emergency service-account key rotation on 2024-07-11 that required manual approval. I'll annotate that event in the timeline and link the incident ticket.
Jenn (auditor): Please mark exceptions clearly. For the RBAC diffs we need signed commit SHAs and deployment timestamps.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll add commit SHAs from our infra repo (git://git.redwood/internal/infra) and attach the CI/CD deployment logs. Example CI snippet we'll include: ```
- commit: 5f3a2b7
- pipeline: infra-prod-rbac
- deployed_at: 2024-07-11T15:22:03Z
```
Kai (infra): For the CloudTrail query I used to pull KMS and IAM events — sharing so you can reproduce: ```
# CloudTrail lookup-events (aws cli)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue="kms.amazonaws.com" --start-time 2023-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z > kms-events.json

# CloudTrail for IAM role/rolepolicy changes
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceType,AttributeValue="AWS::IAM::Role" --start-time 2023-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z > iam-role-events.json
```
Jenn (auditor): Nice. For verification we usually ask for a short Splunk/CloudWatch query too so we can sanity-check timestamps. Can you include one?
Kai (infra): Sure — Splunk example: ```
index=cloudtrail source=aws_cloudtrail eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, resources
```
Ava (sec-eng): We're also adding k8s audit snapshots for rolebindings in prod namespaces. Snapshot path: s3://redwood-evidence/k8s-audit/2024-*/rbac-snapshots.tar.gz. Each snapshot includes `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` output and a digest file.
Jenn (auditor): Can you include the cryptographic digests and a short verification procedure? We prefer SHA256 manifests.
Ava (sec-eng): Yes — manifest format we'll include: ```
- file: rbcsnapshot-2024-07-11.tar.gz
- sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
- verifier: sha256sum rbcsnapshot-2024-07-11.tar.gz
```
Marcus (oncall): OpsBot created ticket RW-EVID-402 for bundling. @OpsBot — can you attach the current evidence pack draft link?
OpsBot: Ticket RW-EVID-402 created and linked: https://tickets.redwood/internal/RW-EVID-402. Preliminary bundle staged at s3://redwood-evidence/drafts/RW-EVID-402/ (presigned link expires in 7 days). :page_with_curl:
Ava (sec-eng): Jenn — two more things: 1) We have a vulnerability triage note where a role with high privileges was created but never assigned actual principal (it was a stale role). We'll include the vuln-triage.md and the mitigation timeline. 2) For any encrypted artifacts, provide the KMS key alias referenced and a KMS decrypt audit (who used the key, what service).
Jenn (auditor): Good. For the KMS decrypt audit we need: key_id, alias, decrypt events (CloudTrail), and IAM principal ARN that called Decrypt. Also timeline linking those decrypts to app deployments or incident responses.
Kai (infra): We'll include a CSV with columns: key_alias,key_id,rotate_enabled,rotation_dates,decrypt_count,last_decrypt_at,sample_principals. Example row: ```
"alias/redwood-secrets-prod","1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab","true","[2022-08-01,2023-08-01,2024-08-01]","42","2024-11-10T04:12:09Z","arn:aws:sts::111111111:assumed-role/redwood-app/instance-1234"
```
Jenn (auditor): That will work. Last ask: can you annotate anywhere we rely on third-party managed services so we can scope shared-control artifacts?
Ava (sec-eng): Yes — we'll add a third_party_controls.md that lists services (SaaS DB, log ingestion, monitoring) and which controls are vendor-managed vs. Redwood-managed.
Marcus (oncall): ETA — I can have the full bundle and control_map up by EOD tomorrow. Can we agree to a follow-up sync after you review the draft?
Jenn (auditor): EOD tomorrow works. We'll review and flag any gaps. Thanks all.
Ava (sec-eng): Thanks — ping me directly if you need faster turnaround. :thumbsup:
